resolved_finding: Calibration criteria are now bound to the exact complete-rule alpha or a declared group alpha, with scenario coverage for each; max(alpha across different groups) cannot justify a looser principal ceiling.
checked_semantics: All method, implementation, decision-rule, candidate, design/family, target and R/T scope bindings stay explicit.
Raw-hypothesis mappings are separate from per-rival requirements; repeating global p as direct contrast is blocked and no universal Holm57 is asserted.
Seed covariance is independently reconstructed from paired individual RMSE trajectories; temporal/interaction covariance and sampling authenticity require external review.
Simultaneous one-sided Hoeffding MC lower bounds for contrast powers and two-sided joint-power bounds have separate eta guarantees, aggregate error bounded by2eta.
Full-rule intersection and remaining direction/margin/effect/CI/adequacy conditions are used in saved power decisions; no observed power or joint90 universal requirement is invented.
No candidate, family, final R/T, actual admitted panels or budget authorization is invented.
No third statistical procedure, actual reviewer, preregistration, human reproduction or R3 is certified by compatible metadata.
Controller does not run or train workloads; hashes alone cannot authenticate external attestations.
scope_choices_not_universal_guide_requir: Own R1/R2 before planning for this proposed route.
Exactly four proposed panels, two diversity axes per additional panel.
A conservative simultaneous MC lower bound at least.90 rather than only a point estimate.
